summary: Phase L retest after the iteration-14 wallet-balance gate fix. CRITICAL invest happy path is now fully working end-to-end, plus all 7 requested retest items pass. Backend: 9/9 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_l.py PASS in 1s (regression + /opportunities/{id}/similar coverage). Verified GET /api/wallet returns wallet.available=828500 for investor; GET /api/opportunities/{id}/similar now defaults to status=open only (verified items=[open,open]); include_all=true accepted. Frontend Playwright (preview URL): (1) login investor@agriflow.ng → /app/opportunities → click Tomato opp → fill ₦10,000 → invest-submit-btn → RiskAck (ack-accredited+ack-understand+ack-confirm) → invest-submit-btn → invest-confirm-modal opens with confirm-amount=₦10,000, confirm-duration='4 months', confirm-target='11%', confirm-payout='₦11,100 +₦1,100 gain', confirm-milestones='Milestones · monitored', confirm-risk-checkbox tickable → confirm-allocate-btn enables → POST /api/opportunities/{id}/invest succeeds → URL=/app/investment-success?id=...&amount=10000&payout=11100&duration=4. (2) Success page renders invest-success-page, invest-success-title='Your capital is now at work.', success-stat-amount=₦10,000, success-stat-duration='4 months', success-stat-payout=₦11,100, success-opp-summary 'Tomato · Ogun…Next update: within 7 days', success-track-btn → /app/portfolio, success-back-to-market → /app/opportunities. (3) Low-balance guard on Rice opp (wallet=818,500, remaining=1,250,000): amount=₦1,000,000 → wallet-fund-modal opens (NOT confirm). (4) Fresh signup test_inv_<ts>@agriflow.ng → /onboarding/profile (pick Passive income → profile-continue-btn) → kyc-skip-btn → wallet-skip-btn → invest-skip-btn → /onboarding/success → success-dashboard-btn label='Start your first investment' → click → URL=/app/first-investment with [data-testid=first-investment-page] present. (5) Urgency badges on /app/opportunities: opp-urgent-closing-* (×2), opp-urgent-funded-* (×1), opp-urgent-investors-* (×2). The 3-day-close opps are surfacing closing badges as expected. rca of the issue: Iter 14 root cause (OpportunityDetail reading user.wallet_balance which was never populated by /auth/me) is fully fixed. New implementation fetches GET /api/wallet on component mount and stores wallet.available in local walletBalance state (initially null). Gate condition is now `balance !== null && balance < n` so the modal only opens when we know balance is truly insufficient — eliminating the false positive that broke the entire conversion funnel. WalletFundModal also refreshes the wallet after a successful fund. Verified by orthogonal tests: 10k under balance → confirm modal opens; 1M over balance but under remaining → wallet-fund-modal opens.
